BiblicalUsage: The Hermons are the peaks of Mount Hermon, named once in the psalmist's cry from the land of Jordan. He remembers God from the hill Mizar and from the Hermonites, his soul cast down within him while the waves of trouble go over his head.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a man can remember God's mountain even when he is far from it, and memory itself becomes a kind of prayer.
